items.rawPrompt:
Aqui está o briefing detalhado para o ensaio fotográfico "A Doce Tensão da Rotina," inspirado na energia das referências visuais fornecidas. O ensaio captura o equilíbrio entre a utilidade de uma frutaria e a intensidade do desejo que as frutas evocam.
 O ensaio é estruturado como uma narrativa em três atos, dividida em um tríptico visual que reflete a doçura e a tensão de lidar com produtos tão sensuais e perecíveis.
 Briefing Fotográfico: A Doce Tensão da Rotina 
 Conceito Criativo: Uma exploração editorial da rotina de Lúcia, proprietária de uma pequena "fruteira" autêntica de bairro. A tensão central reside na desconexão entre o ambiente de varejo (caixas, balanças, azulejos desgastados) e a intensidade do prazer tátil, da cor e do desejo pessoal que as frutas evocam. O visual deve ser energético, acolhedor e levemente sensual, misturando a utilidade do trabalho com a doçura latente.
 Paleta de Cores (Regra 60|30|10): 
 60% (Base/Ambiente): #D8C3A5 (Creme/Terracota Suave) e #9BCF53 (Verde Maçã/Folhagem). Uso principal: Ambientes, caixas, prateleiras, azulejos quentes. 
 30% (Secundária/Foco): #A1343C (Borgonha Profundo) e #E67E22 (Laranja Queimado). Uso secundário: Frutas específicas (uvas, figos, romãs), roupas de Lúcia, objetos de ação. 
 10% (Contraste/Destaque): #F1C40F (Amarelo Ouro Vivo) e #000000 (Preto Fosco). Uso terciário: Detalhes, acessórios, sombras, equipamentos da loja. 
 Atos Narrativos e Direção de Fotos 
 Ato 1: O Preparo e a Doçura Latente (O Acordar da Fruteira) 
 Cena: Lúcia organiza as bancas de frutas logo cedo. A luz da manhã entra e destaca a textura dos produtos. Ela está sozinha, mas a tensão já está lá. 
 Visual e Maquiagem: Cabelo em coque bagunçado, pele dewy com suor sutil. Look confortável e tátil. 
 Conjunto de Roupa: Camiseta de algodão Borgonha (#A1343C) desgastada, calça cargo de algodão Terracota (#D8C3A5), tênis de lona. 
 Composição e Direção: Close-ups táticos. Foco nas mãos tocando frutas delicadamente. O movimento sutil da pele ao ajustar uma caixa. A relação entre a pele e a casca. Inspirado na textura e proximidade de image_1.png . 
 Cores Predominantes: Terracota (#D8C3A5), Verde Maçã (#9BCF53), Laranja Queimado (#E67E22). 
 Ato 2: A Prova do Desejo (O Clímax da Manhã) 
 Cena: O momento de pico do dia. Lúcia para por um segundo. A tensão de todo o trabalho e do desejo se encontram. É um momento editorial de close-up extremo. 
 Visual e Maquiagem: Mais editorial e sensual, mantendo a utilidade. Pele mais suada e brilhante. Olhar direto para a câmera, desafiador e doce. 
 Conjunto de Roupa: O mesmo visual do Ato 1, mas com a camiseta de Borgonha amarrada na cintura, revelando um top de linho Laranja Queimado (#E67E22) por baixo. 
 Composição e Direção: Close-up extremo da boca e dos dentes. Morda uma fruta específica (figo, romã, uva). A casca da fruta sendo exposta. O contraste entre a fruta e a pele. O movimento. Inspirado no close-up na boca e na doçura de image_0.png . 
 Cores Predominantes: Borgonha (#A1343C), Laranja Queimado (#E67E22), Amarelo Ouro (#F1C40F). 
 Ato 3: O Pós-Desejo e a Intimidade Compartilhada (O Fechamento da Loja) 
 Cena: O fim do expediente. O ambiente está mais calmo. Uma segunda pessoa chega para ajudar a fechar a loja. O momento é de conexão e intimidade acolhedora. 
 Visual e Maquiagem: Cabelo solto. Roupa solta e confortável. Pele luminosa e relaxada. 
 Conjunto de Roupa: Vestido de linho solto e fluido, na cor Creme (#D8C3A5) com detalhes sutis em Borgonha (#A1343C). Confortável, acolhedor e sensual. 
 Segunda Pessoa (Look): Camiseta de algodão Preto Fosco (#000000), calça jeans desgastada. 
 Composição e Direção: Close-up extremo de duas pessoas compartilhando uma fruta (como na referência). O corpo de um apoiado no outro entre as caixas de madeira. A tensão é acolhedora, não agressiva. A luz é mais suave (pôr do sol). O suor nas peles se misturando. Inspirado na intimidade extrema de image_2.png . 
 Cores Predominantes: Terracota (#D8C3A5), Borgonha (#A1343C), Preto Fosco (#000000). 
 Execução Visual 
 Ambiente: Uma fruteira autêntica, não uma loja de luxo. Caixas de madeira, balanças antigas, prateleiras de metal, azulejos brancos desgastados, cartazes de preços escritos à mão. 
 Estilo: Fotografia de filme com grão fino e textural. Luz natural/estúdio mista. 
 Frutas: Romãs, uvas borgonha, physalis, toranjas, figos, bananas amarelas. 
 Cores e Texturas: O suor na pele, a casca das frutas, a madeira das caixas, a suavidade do linho, o desgastado do algodão. 
 Tensão Central: O conflito entre o ambiente de varejo e o desejo pessoal evocado pelas frutas. 
 O ensaio deve capturar o prazer tátil, a doçura e a tensão de lidar com produtos tão sensuais e perecíveis.

items.rawPrompt:
STUDIO EDITORIAL — DUAL SUBJECT / SINGLE SHOT v1

INPUT A (model 1 image): [attach]
INPUT B (model 2 image): [attach]
INPUT C (clothing model 1): [attach]
INPUT D (clothing model 2): [attach]

---

STEP 1 — VISUAL EXTRACTION (internal, do not output):

From INPUT A — Model 1:
Extract: skin tone value (light / medium / tan / deep),
skin undertone (warm / cool / neutral), body proportions,
hair color and texture, facial structure, estimated height
and frame relative to model 2.

From INPUT B — Model 2:
Extract: skin tone value, skin undertone, body proportions,
hair color and texture, facial structure, estimated height
and frame relative to model 1.

CONTRAST RULE: identify the primary visual contrast
between the two subjects — tone, height, hair, or build.
This contrast must be legible and preserved in the final
image. Do not average or blend any physical features
between subjects. Each model must remain individually
identifiable and true to her input.

From INPUT C — Clothing Model 1:
Extract: clothing value (light / medium / dark), dominant
color temperature (warm / cool / neutral), fabric weight
and surface language (matte, glossy, washed, fluid,
structured, raw), silhouette category, styling signals.

From INPUT D — Clothing Model 2:
Extract: same fields as INPUT C.

WARDROBE HARMONY CHECK: assess whether the two looks
share a visual language (tonal family, silhouette logic,
cultural coding) — use this to determine the spatial
and compositional relationship in STEP 3.

---

STEP 2 — BACKGROUND SELECTION (internal):

FIXED: seamless warm off-white infinity curve.
No texture on backdrop. Floor and wall are one unbroken
continuous surface. No horizon line visible.

Lighting must be consistent across both subjects —
neutral white balance 5500K. Key light simulates a single
large soft-box source at 30–45° to the frame, creating
coherent shadow logic across both bodies.

No subject should be lit differently from the other
unless the pose places one naturally in partial shadow —
in which case shadow fall-off must feel intentional,
not accidental.

Rim or separation light acceptable and encouraged —
both subjects must read clearly and independently
against the off-white field.

---

STEP 3 — POSE & COMPOSITION (internal):

PHILOSOPHY — TWO SUBJECTS:
The dynamic between two subjects is a relationship,
not a duplication. Avoid mirroring at all costs.
One subject leads — the other responds or diverges.
Silhouettes must read as two distinct graphic shapes
that coexist without merging.

SPATIAL LOGIC — choose one:

  OPTION A — DEPTH OFFSET:
  One subject placed closer to camera in slight foreground,
  the other behind and laterally offset. Bodies angled
  toward the same direction or slightly toward each other.
  Creates depth and avoids flat, side-by-side symmetry.
  Camera: eye level to slight low angle.

  OPTION B — BACK TO BACK:
  Subjects standing back-to-back, bodies touching or
  nearly touching. One faces camera directly, one faces
  away or 3/4 away. Gazes diverge — one into lens,
  one off-frame. Strong graphic silhouette read.
  Camera: eye level, medium shot waist-up or full body.

  OPTION C — VERTICAL SPLIT:
  One subject standing, one crouched, seated, or on
  floor beside her. Vertical contrast in height creates
  compositional tension. Both facing camera but at
  different angles. One gaze direct, one averted.
  Camera: eye level or slight low angle to honor
  the standing figure.

  OPTION D — ASYMMETRIC FACING:
  Subjects facing each other but not symmetrically —
  one turned more toward camera, one more in profile.
  Bodies close but not touching. Tension in the space
  between them. Gazes: one toward camera, one toward
  the other subject.
  Camera: 3/4 angle to the pair, not straight-on.

GAZE RULE (mandatory):
Gazes must never mirror each other.
  — If Model 1 looks into lens: Model 2 looks away,
    downward, or toward Model 1.
  — If both gaze away: they must gaze in different
    directions.
  — Direct double gaze into lens is permitted only
    if the pose creates enough asymmetry elsewhere
    (body angle, arm position, height differential)
    to prevent a symmetrical, catalog-style read.

ARM AND HAND RULE (mandatory):
Arms must not mirror each other across subjects.
If Model 1 has one arm raised, Model 2's arms
should be neutral, lowered, or differently active.
Hands must be visible for at least one subject.
Hands must be anatomically precise — no hidden
or ambiguous hand placement.

ATTITUDE RULE:
The two subjects do not need to relate narratively.
They may exist in the same frame without acknowledging
each other. The image is about coexistence of presence,
not a story between characters. No forced interaction,
no theatrical staging.

---

STEP 4 — FINAL IMAGE OUTPUT:

Generate a single, high-resolution studio editorial
photograph. One frame. Two subjects. Not a grid.
Not a composite diptych. Not a contact sheet.
Both subjects must appear within a single continuous image.

SUBJECT 1: exact model from INPUT A wearing exact garments
from INPUT C. Preserve all of: skin tone, face, body
proportions, hair, and every clothing detail — color,
texture, stitching, hardware, logo placement.

SUBJECT 2: exact model from INPUT B wearing exact garments
from INPUT D. Same preservation rules as Subject 1.

IDENTITY INTEGRITY: both models must remain individually
recognizable and true to their input images. Do not blend
facial features, do not alter skin tones, do not average
body proportions. Each is a distinct individual.

POSE: as selected in Step 3. Asymmetric, intentional,
editorial. Not catalog, not commercial, not forced
interaction. Two presences sharing a frame.

BACKGROUND: seamless warm off-white infinity curve.
No props, no furniture, no texture on backdrop.

FORMAT: portrait orientation preferred (4:5 or 2:3).
If spatial relationship demands wider framing,
landscape (3:2) is acceptable. Full bleed.
No border, no text, no watermark, no frame.

LIGHTING: single coherent soft-box light source at
30–45°, fill ratio 1:2 to 1:3, consistent across
both subjects. Shadow logic must be physically coherent —
both figures lit from the same source direction.
Neutral white balance 5500K. No colored gels.
Rim or separation light acceptable on both or either
subject where necessary to prevent merging with
the off-white backdrop.

QUALITY MARKERS:
— Realistic skin micro-texture on both subjects:
  pores, natural moisture, subsurface scattering.
  No airbrushing, no smoothing.
— Faithful fabric reproduction for both outfits:
  exact color, texture, drape, weight, finish.
  No color shift, no detail loss.
— Natural hair texture and movement for each model
  individually — do not homogenize hair quality.
— Clothing fits and drapes realistically on each
  individual body.
— Gaze: direct, semi-direct, or deliberately averted
  with intention — following GAZE RULE above.
  Never commercial-catalog expression, never forced smile.
— Hands and feet in frame must be anatomically precise
  for both subjects.

CAMERA: 85mm lens aesthetic as default for full-body
and mid-body shots. 50mm if spatial relationship
requires wider coverage of two figures. Depth of field
calibrated to ensure both subjects are in acceptable
focus — avoid shallow DoF that renders one figure
blurry unless foreground/background depth separation
is intentional and compositionally justified.
Subtle natural grain. No over-sharpening, no fake HDR,
no preset color grading.

AESTHETIC REFERENCE: Vogue Italia, System Magazine,
Acne Paper, i-D, CR Fashion Book.
Restrained but charged. Precise and bodily.
Not commercial. Not catalog. Not influencer.
Not a friendship photo. Not a campaign smile.

---

STRICT NEGATIVES:
multiple panels, composite grid, flat lay, mannequin,
diptych format, pure white #fff backdrop,
black backdrop, chromatic colored backdrop,
mirrored or symmetric poses between subjects,
identical gaze direction on both models,
merged or blended silhouettes,
averaged or blended facial features between subjects,
altered skin tone on either model,
changed body proportions on either model,
changed clothing colors or textures,
logo modification, airbrushed skin, plastic finish,
3D render feel, cartoon aesthetic, neon glow,
fake HDR, ring-light halo, catalog pose,
commercial retail expression, forced smile,
forced narrative interaction between subjects,
oversaturated, heavy vignette, watermark,
text overlay, symmetrical mirrored composition,
hands invisible or hidden on both subjects,
dead or vacant gaze on both subjects simultaneously,
straight-on flat camera angle with no intention,
one subject visually erasing or dominating the other
to the point of illegibility.

in which case shadow fall-off must feel intentional,
not accidental.

Rim or separation light acceptable and encouraged —
both subjects must read clearly and independently
against the off-white field.

---

STEP 3 — POSE & COMPOSITION (internal):

PHILOSOPHY — TWO SUBJECTS:
The dynamic between two subjects is a relationship,
not a duplication. Avoid mirroring at all costs.
One subject leads — the other responds or diverges.
Silhouettes must read as two distinct graphic shapes
that coexist without merging.

SPATIAL LOGIC — choose one:

  OPTION A — DEPTH OFFSET:
  One subject placed closer to camera in slight foreground,
  the other behind and laterally offset. Bodies angled
  toward the same direction or slightly toward each other.
  Creates depth and avoids flat, side-by-side symmetry.
  Camera: eye level to slight low angle.

  OPTION B — BACK TO BACK:
  Subjects standing back-to-back, bodies touching or
  nearly touching. One faces camera directly, one faces
  away or 3/4 away. Gazes diverge — one into lens,
  one off-frame. Strong graphic silhouette read.
  Camera: eye level, medium shot waist-up or full body.

  OPTION C — VERTICAL SPLIT:
  One subject standing, one crouched, seated, or on
  floor beside her. Vertical contrast in height creates
  compositional tension. Both facing camera but at
  different angles. One gaze direct, one averted.
  Camera: eye level or slight low angle to honor
  the standing figure.

  OPTION D — ASYMMETRIC FACING:
  Subjects facing each other but not symmetrically —
  one turned more toward camera, one more in profile.
  Bodies close but not touching. Tension in the space
  between them. Gazes: one toward camera, one toward
  the other subject.
  Camera: 3/4 angle to the pair, not straight-on.

GAZE RULE (mandatory):
Gazes must never mirror each other.
  — If Model 1 looks into lens: Model 2 looks away,
    downward, or toward Model 1.
  — If both gaze away: they must gaze in different
    directions.
  — Direct double gaze into lens is permitted only
    if the pose creates enough asymmetry elsewhere
    (body angle, arm position, height differential)
    to prevent a symmetrical, catalog-style read.

ARM AND HAND RULE (mandatory):
Arms must not mirror each other across subjects.
If Model 1 has one arm raised, Model 2's arms
should be neutral, lowered, or differently active.
Hands must be visible for at least one subject.
Hands must be anatomically precise — no hidden
or ambiguous hand placement.

ATTITUDE RULE:
The two subjects do not need to relate narratively.
They may exist in the same frame without acknowledging
each other. The image is about coexistence of presence,
not a story between characters. No forced interaction,
no theatrical staging.

---

STEP 4 — FINAL IMAGE OUTPUT:

Generate a single, high-resolution studio editorial
photograph. One frame. Two subjects. Not a grid.
Not a composite diptych. Not a contact sheet.
Both subjects must appear within a single continuous image.

SUBJECT 1: exact model from INPUT A wearing exact garments
from INPUT C. Preserve all of: skin tone, face, body
proportions, hair, and every clothing detail — color,
texture, stitching, hardware, logo placement.

SUBJECT 2: exact model from INPUT B wearing exact garments
from INPUT D. Same preservation rules as Subject 1.

IDENTITY INTEGRITY: both models must remain individually
recognizable and true to their input images. Do not blend
facial features, do not alter skin tones, do not average
body proportions. Each is a distinct individual.

POSE: as selected in Step 3. Asymmetric, intentional,
editorial. Not catalog, not commercial, not forced
interaction. Two presences sharing a frame.

BACKGROUND: seamless warm off-white infinity curve.
No props, no furniture, no texture on backdrop.

FORMAT: portrait orientation preferred (4:5 or 2:3).
If spatial relationship demands wider framing,
landscape (3:2) is acceptable. Full bleed.
No border, no text, no watermark, no frame.

LIGHTING: single coherent soft-box light source at
30–45°, fill ratio 1:2 to 1:3, consistent across
both subjects. Shadow logic must be physically coherent —
both figures lit from the same source direction.
Neutral white balance 5500K. No colored gels.
Rim or separation light acceptable on both or either
subject where necessary to prevent merging with
the off-white backdrop.

QUALITY MARKERS:
— Realistic skin micro-texture on both subjects:
  pores, natural moisture, subsurface scattering.
  No airbrushing, no smoothing.
— Faithful fabric reproduction for both outfits:
  exact color, texture, drape, weight, finish.
  No color shift, no detail loss.
— Natural hair texture and movement for each model
  individually — do not homogenize hair quality.
— Clothing fits and drapes realistically on each
  individual body.
— Gaze: direct, semi-direct, or deliberately averted
  with intention — following GAZE RULE above.
  Never commercial-catalog expression, never forced smile.
— Hands and feet in frame must be anatomically precise
  for both subjects.

CAMERA: 85mm lens aesthetic as default for full-body
and mid-body shots. 50mm if spatial relationship
requires wider coverage of two figures. Depth of field
calibrated to ensure both subjects are in acceptable
focus — avoid shallow DoF that renders one figure
blurry unless foreground/background depth separation
is intentional and compositionally justified.
Subtle natural grain. No over-sharpening, no fake HDR,
no preset color grading.

AESTHETIC REFERENCE: Vogue Italia, System Magazine,
Acne Paper, i-D, CR Fashion Book.
Restrained but charged. Precise and bodily.
Not commercial. Not catalog. Not influencer.
Not a friendship photo. Not a campaign smile.

---

STRICT NEGATIVES:
multiple panels, composite grid, flat lay, mannequin,
diptych format, pure white #fff backdrop,
black backdrop, chromatic colored backdrop,
mirrored or symmetric poses between subjects,
identical gaze direction on both models,
merged or blended silhouettes,
averaged or blended facial features between subjects,
altered skin tone on either model,
changed body proportions on either model,
changed clothing colors or textures,
logo modification, airbrushed skin, plastic finish,
3D render feel, cartoon aesthetic, neon glow,
fake HDR, ring-light halo, catalog pose,
commercial retail expression, forced smile,
forced narrative interaction between subjects,
oversaturated, heavy vignette, watermark,
text overlay, symmetrical mirrored composition,
hands invisible or hidden on both subjects,
dead or vacant gaze on both subjects simultaneously,
straight-on flat camera angle with no intention,
one subject visually erasing or dominating the other
to the point of illegibility.

}

---

STEP 1 — VISUAL EXTRACTION (internal, do not output):

From INPUT A — Model:
Extract: skin tone value (light / medium / tan / deep),
skin undertone (warm / cool / neutral),
body proportions, hair color and texture, facial structure.

From INPUT B — Clothing:
Extract: clothing value (light / medium / dark),
dominant color temperature (warm / cool / neutral),
fabric weight and surface language (matte, glossy, washed,
fluid, structured, raw), silhouette category, styling signals,
cultural or subcultural coding of the look.

Use these extracted values to determine which environmental
elements should contrast or harmonize with the garment
in the background scene.

---

STEP 2 — ENVIRONMENT & LIGHT SELECTION (internal):

FIXED SETTING: Rustic Mediterranean interior — a sun-drenched
kitchen or domestic space with authentic age and texture.

BACKGROUND ELEMENTS (render out-of-focus, as soft environmental
depth — not props, not styled objects):
— Plaster walls with warm yellow-ochre or faded sage patina
— A large, slightly overexposed window with semi-transparent
  white linen or sheer cotton curtains, diffusing hard sunlight
  into atmospheric soft light
— Glimpses of antique wooden cabinetry or a mosaic-top table
— Optional: dark architectural archway framing the far edge
— No modern elements, no visible branding, no clean surfaces

DEPTH TREATMENT:
The background must feel lived-in and dimensional but
subordinate to the subject. Render it with heavy bokeh
(f/2 to f/2.8 equivalent), preserving only color masses
and tonal warmth — never competing with the model.
The sense of place is felt, not read.

LIGHTING ARCHITECTURE:
Primary: Soft, directional natural window light from the right,
wrapping around the subject with long, gentle transitions
between highlight and shadow. No hard lines.
Secondary: Ambient fill from the warm interior environment,
slightly lifting the shadow side without neutralizing the
chiaroscuro structure.
Rim/separation: Optional — a subtle backlight halo from the
window in the rear plane, separating dark hair from background.

Lighting ratio: 1:2.5 to 1:3 (moody but not dramatic).
Avoid flat, overhead, or symmetrical illumination.
Light must sculpt — jawline, collarbone, fabric drape.

WHITE BALANCE: Warm Daylight — 5200K to 5800K.
Skin should render with a creamy, peachy luminosity.
Shadows lean slightly warm, never cyan or teal.
Color palette anchor: muted blues against warm ochre/gold
earth tones. The garment's color temperature (extracted in
Step 1) determines whether the scene skews warmer or cooler
within this range.

---

STEP 3 — CAMERA & FILM SELECTION (internal):

PHILOSOPHY: The image must feel analog, tactile, and human.
Not studio-clean. Not digital-sharp. Every technical choice
should serve organic, lived-in authenticity.

CAMERA SYSTEM: Medium format analog aesthetic.
Reference bodies: Pentax 67 II, Mamiya RZ67, Contax 645,
or Hasselblad 500C/M — choose based on the mood extracted
from INPUT B.
Structured/editorial garment → Pentax 67 (punchy, graphic)
Fluid/delicate garment → Contax 645 (ethereal, smooth)
Raw/utilitarian garment → Mamiya RZ67 (grounded, weighty)

LENS: 85mm–110mm equivalent.
Moderate telephoto compression.
Shallow depth of field — subject tack sharp,
environment dissolved into warm color fields.

FILM STOCK EMULATION:
Default: Kodak Portra 400 (+0.5 to +1 EV overexposure)
— lifts shadows, preserves pastel tones, renders skin
  with creamy luminosity and natural moisture.
Cool-toned garment: Fujifilm Pro 400H
— slight cyan push in shadows, ethereal highlight rolloff.
High-saturation garment: Kodak Ektar 100
— ultra-vivid color, exceptional fabric texture rendering.

GRAIN: Authentic, organic midtone grain structure.
Visible but not aggressive. Tactile, not noisy.
No digital noise simulation. No HDR. No oversharpening.

---

STEP 4 — FINAL IMAGE OUTPUT:

Generate a single, high-resolution analog editorial photograph.
One frame only. No grid, no composite, no diptych.

SUBJECT: exact model from INPUT A wearing exact garments
from INPUT B. Preserve 100% identity and clothing fidelity.
Skin un-retouched: pores, micro-texture, natural moisture,
subtle imperfections intact.

POSE: Follow POSE DIRECTION strictly.
Expressive, controlled, attitude-forward.
Body partially turned, one shoulder forward.
No catalog pose. No passive expression. No forced smile.
Hands visible — anatomically correct, naturally active.

ENVIRONMENT: Soft Mediterranean interior depth behind the
subject. Warm, blurred, atmospheric. Felt, not described.

FORMAT: Portrait orientation (4:5 preferred), full bleed.
Optional: authentic analog film rebate border (thin black
frame edge). No watermark, no text overlay.

---

QUALITY MARKERS:

— Realistic skin texture: pores, micro-details, natural sheen
— No airbrushing, no smoothing, no plastic skin
— Accurate fabric rendering: weave, drape, sheen, stitch detail
— Natural hair behavior — movement, flyaways, organic volume
— True-to-body clothing fit and gravity-correct drape
— Intentional gaze (direct, averted, or confrontational)
— Analog artifacts welcome: subtle halation, slight lens glow
  around window highlights, authentic grain in shadow areas
— Environmental warmth readable in skin color reflection

---

CAMERA SUMMARY:

— 85–110mm medium format lens aesthetic
— Shallow depth of field (f/2 to f/2.8)
— Organic analog grain
— No HDR, no oversharpening, no artificial effects
— No ring light, no beauty dish, no studio flat light

---

AESTHETIC REFERENCE:

Vogue Italia (analog era), Acne Paper, System Magazine,
Purple Fashion, Self Service — editorial tradition where
environment and body coexist with equal weight.
Warm, tactile, human. Fashion-forward but grounded in place.
Not commercial. Not influencer. Not white-background catalog.

---

STRICT NEGATIVES:

multiple panels, composite, mannequin, modern interior,
clean white walls, studio backdrop, pure flat background,
colored backdrop, digital-clean skin, airbrushed skin,
plastic skin, CGI look, cartoon style, HDR, ring light,
flat lighting, symmetry pose, arms at sides, hands hidden,
forced smile, lifeless expression, oversaturated colors,
heavy vignette, teal/orange grade, face alteration,
body distortion, clothing changes, logo changes,
watermark, text overlay, visible modern objects,
any element anachronistic to rustic Mediterranean setting

STEP 2 — ENVIRONMENT & LIGHT SELECTION (internal):

FIXED SETTING: Rustic Mediterranean interior — a sun-drenched
kitchen or domestic space with authentic age and texture.

BACKGROUND ELEMENTS (render out-of-focus, as soft environmental
depth — not props, not styled objects):
— Plaster walls with warm yellow-ochre or faded sage patina
— A large, slightly overexposed window with semi-transparent
  white linen or sheer cotton curtains, diffusing hard sunlight
  into atmospheric soft light
— Glimpses of antique wooden cabinetry or a mosaic-top table
— Optional: dark architectural archway framing the far edge

DEPTH TREATMENT:
The background must feel lived-in and dimensional but
subordinate to the subject. Render it with heavy bokeh
(f/2 to f/2.8 equivalent), preserving only color masses
and tonal warmth — never competing with the model.
The sense of place is felt, not read.

LIGHTING ARCHITECTURE:
Primary: Soft, directional natural window light from the right,
wrapping around the subject with long, gentle transitions
between highlight and shadow. No hard lines.
Secondary: Ambient fill from the warm interior environment,
slightly lifting the shadow side without neutralizing the
chiaroscuro structure.
Rim/separation: Optional — a subtle backlight halo from the
window in the rear plane, separating dark hair from background.

Lighting ratio: 1:2.5 to 1:3 (moody but not dramatic).
Avoid flat, overhead, or symmetrical illumination.
Light must sculpt — jawline, collarbone, fabric drape.

WHITE BALANCE: Warm Daylight — 5200K to 5800K.
Skin should render with a creamy, peachy luminosity.
Shadows lean slightly warm, never cyan or teal.
Color palette anchor: muted blues against warm ochre/gold
earth tones. The garment's color temperature (extracted in

Fluid/delicate garment → Contax 645 (ethereal, smooth)
Raw/utilitarian garment → Mamiya RZ67 (grounded, weighty)

LENS: 85mm–110mm equivalent.
Moderate telephoto compression.
Shallow depth of field — subject tack sharp,
environment dissolved into warm color fields.

FILM STOCK EMULATION:
Default: Kodak Portra 400 (+0.5 to +1 EV overexposure)
— lifts shadows, preserves pastel tones, renders skin
  with creamy luminosity and natural moisture.
Cool-toned garment: Fujifilm Pro 400H
— slight cyan push in shadows, ethereal highlight rolloff.
High-saturation garment: Kodak Ektar 100
— ultra-vivid color, exceptional fabric texture rendering.

GRAIN: Authentic, organic midtone grain structure.
Visible but not aggressive. Tactile, not noisy.
No digital noise simulation. No HDR. No oversharpening.

---

STEP 4 — FINAL IMAGE OUTPUT:

Generate a single, high-resolution analog editorial photograph.
One frame only. No grid, no composite, no diptych.

SUBJECT: exact model from INPUT A wearing exact garments
from INPUT B. Preserve 100% identity and clothing fidelity.
Skin un-retouched: pores, micro-texture, natural moisture,
subtle imperfections intact.

Expressive, controlled, attitude-forward.
Body partially turned, one shoulder forward.
No catalog pose. No passive expression. No forced smile.
Hands visible — anatomically correct, naturally active.

ENVIRONMENT: Soft Mediterranean interior depth behind the
subject. Warm, blurred, atmospheric. Felt, not described.

FORMAT: Portrait orientation (4:5 preferred), full bleed.
Optional: authentic analog film rebate border (thin black
frame edge). No watermark, no text overlay.

QUALITY MARKERS:

— Realistic skin texture: pores, micro-details, natural sheen
— No airbrushing, no smoothing, no plastic skin
— Accurate fabric rendering: weave, drape, sheen, stitch detail
— Natural hair behavior — movement, flyaways, organic volume
— True-to-body clothing fit and gravity-correct drape
— Intentional gaze (direct, averted, or confrontational)
— Analog artifacts welcome: subtle halation, slight lens glow
  around window highlights, authentic grain in shadow areas
— Environmental warmth readable in skin color reflection

---

CAMERA SUMMARY:

— 85–110mm medium format lens aesthetic
— Shallow depth of field (f/2 to f/2.8)
— Organic analog grain
— No HDR, no oversharpening, no artificial effects
— No ring light, no beauty dish, no studio flat light

AESTHETIC REFERENCE:

Vogue Italia (analog era), Acne Paper, System Magazine,
Purple Fashion, Self Service — editorial tradition where
environment and body coexist with equal weight.
Warm, tactile, human. Fashion-forward but grounded in place.
Not commercial. Not influencer. Not white-background catalog.

any element anachronistic to rustic Mediterranean setting

Entendido. Com base na análise FDR e seguindo a Teoria de Intenção do Framework FDR v1.3, extraí os elementos principais da imagem fornecida (pose, ângulo, trajes, acessórios e a característica principal: a sola vermelha do salto) para criar um prompt hiper-realista, focado no dispositivo e com injeção de artefatos para combater a perfeição da IA.
 Aqui está o prompt gerado:

 # [SHOT_TYPE]
medium-shot selfie captured iPhone 13 front camera in portrait orientation,
# [CAPTURE QUALITY]
harsh on-camera flash, amateur snapshot quality, ugly realism, visible digital noise in shadows, slight grain, compressed look, accidental slight motion blur on hand due to holding phone,
# [STORAGE CONTEXT]
iCloud backup archive sept 2023, photo dump folder,
# [VISUAL DESCRIPTION (DENSA)]
ground level view. a young woman with long, straight dark brown hair is sitting casually on a light wood grain floor, angled slightly away but turning to face the mirror she is taking the photo in. she wears a plain black sleeveless tank-top (cami) and black bike shorts. her gaze is directed at the phone screen she holds up (the phone blocks her nose/mouth region, as seen in image_0.png). a delicate silver pearl necklace and a matching delicate silver anklet on her left ankle are visible. her legs are splayed slightly, pointing towards the camera/mirror. she wears glossy black patent leather high heel pumps, the distinct bright red undersole of the left shoe (closest to the camera) is sharply defined and a major focus, showing signs of wear and scuffs on the red paint. the background is a simple corner of a bedroom, light beige textured walls, a closed dark wood door with a silver handle to the left, and blurred clutter (perhaps clothes/bed) in the background.
# [LIGHTING]
harsh indoor mixed lighting, strong direct flash from the phone camera causing significant glare on the mirror and reflective surfaces (patent heels, wall paint), deep shadows, dim background,
# [LOCATION]
curitiba parana brazil,
# [FILENAMES]
IMG_20230915_231140.heic,
# [METADATA EXTRACTION]
icloud cache extracted 2023, photo captured 23:11 local time,
# [IDENTIFIERS]
 character_fernanda_sp_93,

 Validação: [SHOT_TYPE] (iPhone 13 Front Camera): Ancoragem explícita no dispositivo para garantir os parâmetros da câmera (sensor pequeno, abertura) e evitar "luz cinematográfica". A especificação "front camera" para o selfie no espelho injeta o ruído característico. 
 Validação: [CAPTURE QUALITY] (Harsh Flash, Ugly Realism): Injeção crítica de artefatos. O "harsh on-camera flash" é o elemento principal para recriar o visual chapado e com reflexos estourados da imagem original. O token "ugly realism" instrui a IA a não embelezar a cena. 
 Validação: [VISUAL DESCRIPTION] (Scuffed Red Sole): A descrição denso-focada garante que o elemento de destaque (as solas vermelhas) não seja apenas limpo e perfeito (viés de IA), mas tenha o realismo de uso ("signs of wear and scuffs"). A descrição do posicionamento corporal é precisa para manter a pose. 
 Validação: [LOCATION] (Curitiba, Brazil) + [IDENTIFIERS]: Ativação do Arquétipo Regional. O local "Curitiba" ajuda a filtrar os biotipos mais comuns na base de dados de mídia social daquela região, e o [IDENTIFIERS] "locks" um rosto específico dentro desse arquétipo, quebrando o "rosto padrão" de IA.

items.rawPrompt:
Criar imagem: utilize a imagem anexada como referência facial principal com elevada precisão. Preservar a identidade reconhecível, proporções faciais exatas, assimetria natural, caráter facial autêntico, tez clara com subtom neutro a quente, textura de pele autêntica e rubor rosado difuso natural nas maçãs do rosto e ponta do nariz.

Fotografia espontânea captada por telemóvel num vão de escadas interior, tirada em ângulo picado acentuado de cima para baixo (selfie em perspetiva superior). O enquadramento abrange desde o topo da cabeça até aos pés apoiados no chão, com uma ligeira inclinação dinâmica. O ambiente transmite uma sensação quotidiana e descontraída, sem pose artificial ou iluminação de estúdio profissional.

BODY MECHANICS
A mecânica corporal é fortemente orientada pela perspetiva vertical descendente. A cabeça está inclinada para trás e voltada diretamente para cima em direção à lente, com o queixo ligeiramente erguido e os olhos totalmente focados na câmara superior. Existe uma contra-rotação subtil entre a caixa torácica e a bacia: o tronco projeta-se ligeiramente para a frente com curvatura lombar suave, enquanto a anca recua ligeiramente em relação aos ombros. Assimetria marcada na cintura escapular: o ombro direito encontra-se elevado e projetado para a frente em extensão para segurar o dispositivo fora de campo, enquanto o ombro esquerdo está relaxado, descaído e orientado para baixo. O braço esquerdo estende-se verticalmente ao longo do tronco, segurando um maço espesso de papéis contra a anca, com a respetiva mão a segurar um par de sandálias de sola grossa. Pernas retas e alinhadas, com os pés posicionados juntos no chão em ângulo convergente visto de cima. Evitar simetria rígida de manequim, torso perfeitamente alinhado com as ancas, postura estática de catálogo e clavículas artificiais.

Cabelo castanho escuro de comprimento médio, solto sobre os ombros, com franja reta ligeiramente desfiada a repousar sobre a testa e as sobrancelhas. Mechas laterais finas emolduram a mandíbula, com textura natural ligeiramente desalinhada e fios individuais finos visíveis destacados pela iluminação ambiente.

Top azul claro de mangas curtas franzidas com decote quadrado amplo e profundo, debruado a renda de algodão branca/bege em toda a orla. Construção justa com costuras verticais estruturadas no busto e corte curto revelando o abdómen. Sobre o decote cruza diagonalmente uma alça única de ganga azul clara desgastada com fivela metálica retangular. Calças de ganga de cintura descaída em lavagem azul clara. Fio metálico prateado fino com pequeno pendente circular/coroa sobre a clavícula. Botins rasteiros em camurça castanha clara nos pés e um par de sandálias pretas de plataforma volumosa seguradas na mão esquerda, juntamente com folhas de papel impressas com grelhas técnicas.

Pele luminosa com acabamento natural, poros visíveis e sem efeito ceroso. Realce subtil de oleosidade natural na ponte do nariz e na testa. Maquilhagem estilo "sun-kissed" com blush rosado acetinado aplicado densamente nas maçãs do rosto e estendido suavemente pela ponta do nariz. Olhos definidos com delineado fino, máscara de pestanas evidente, sobrancelhas castanhas naturais e lábios hidratados com brilho suave e coloração rosada neutra.

Iluminação mista com fonte natural oblíqua e luz ambiente suave. Um feixe de sol direto rasante entra pela diagonal esquerda inferior, gerando sombras geométricas nítidas na parede branca texturada e na borda dos papéis. O rosto e a parte superior do corpo são preenchidos por iluminação difusa indireta, criando transições suaves de sombra na clavícula e no decote.

Espaço interior correspondente a um patamar ou patamar intermédio de escadas. À direita, degraus de madeira ou alcatifa castanha escura com frisos metálicos dourados nos rebordos e rodapé em madeira envernizada. À esquerda, parede plana com acabamento de reboco fino texturado em tom bege claro. Chão plano em pavimento vinílico ou betonilha cinzenta clara.

Lente grande angular típica de câmara frontal de telemóvel (equivalente a 24-28 mm), provocando distorção de perspetiva nativa onde o rosto e o torso superior aparecem ligeiramente ampliados e os pés comprimidos em escala. Profundidade de campo ampla sem desfoque artificial (bokeh) de modo retrato, preservando textura nítida tanto no tecido como na parede de fundo. Foco primário na expressão facial, textura da pele e detalhes do decote em renda.

Reforço anatómico: articulação realista da escápula e ombro em elevação unilateral, transição fidedigna entre a inclinação cervical e o plano torácico, compressão lombar compatível com a vista superior e ancoragem correta do peso corporal sobre os pés vistos em perspetiva forçada.

--ar 3:4

Negative prompt: simetria corporal perfeita, pose rígida de estúdio, ombros alinhados horizontalmente, braços em posição espelhada, textura de pele plástica ou aerografada, filtro de beleza artificial, desfoque de lente DSLR profissional, modo retrato simulado, fundo cinematográfico artificial, mãos com anomalias anatómicas, dedos fundidos ou em número incorreto, sobre-exposição digital estridente, maquilhagem 3D brilhante irrealista, proporções de perspetiva corrigidas artificialmente, molduras, marcas de água.

Extreme depth of field focused on the surface bubbles. 8k resolution, ultra-sharp details showing every individual bubble membrane and the crystalline texture of the ice. No airbrushing; maintain natural liquid imperfections.

The scene is an infinite wireframe terrain stretching to the horizon, built entirely from a fine triangulated mesh of glowing thread-like lines against a soft ivory-cream void (#F0EEE6). The topology rises from a flat, orderly grid plane in the foreground — calm, evenly spaced, rendered in cool slate-blue (#5A7A8C) — into an increasingly chaotic mountainous ridge at the horizon, where the mesh folds into dense organic peaks in moss-olive and deep forest green (#5C6B3F, #2F3D22). Where the ordered grid meets the wild ridge, a jagged fault line of molten terracotta and amber threads (#D46A3C, #E8934A) cuts diagonally across the landscape, like raw data breaking through structure. No solid surfaces exist — only line, node, and intersection, as if the entire terrain is being computed and rendered in real time. Above the ridge, a flat diffuse light source washes the peaks in warm backlight, casting long soft gradients across the mesh without ever fully illuminating it — the light source itself stays hidden beyond the horizon. Subtle particle nodes and floating vertex points drift just above the surface like suspended data points. Octane Render 8K, vast negative space above the horizon line, wireframe rendered with subpixel anti-aliasing, mood: order dissolving into wild computation, elegant and analytical.

items.rawPrompt:
#prompt 1 RETRATO lifestyle-candid 3 jovem-com-coroa-de-flores (v2)

[IDENTITY LOCK]
Criar imagem: utilizar a imagem anexada como referência principal de rosto, cabelo e tom de pele, com elevada precisão. Preservar a identidade reconhecível, as proporções faciais exatas, a assimetria natural dos olhos, as pintas e imperfeições, e as pontas do cabelo mais claras. Não idealizar nem simetrizar.

[VISUAL CONTEXT :: LINHAGEM E REGISTRO]
primary_lineage: Lifestyle / selfie casual de celular
direction_spectrum_score: 3
vocabulary_register:
required_terms: selfie espontânea, luz como protagonista, naturalidade sem esforço, descontraído
forbidden_terms: rígido, coreografado, precisão de estúdio, controlado, posado
Toda a linguagem descritiva deste prompt é regida por este registo.

[SUBJECT :: EXPRESSÃO E POSE]
Jovem mulher com expressão calma e intensa, quase séria, olhando direto para a lente. Lábios entreabertos, relaxados. Olhos assimétricos: o olho esquerdo do quadro é mais baixo e redondo, e o direito é mais estreito e capta um brilho âmbar do sol na íris. Cabeça levemente inclinada para a frente e para o lado, com a linha dos olhos subindo cerca de 15–20° para a direita do quadro. Câmera acima do rosto, num ângulo alto. Só um pedaço do ombro e da manga de uma camisa vermelha aparece nos cantos inferiores.

[SURFACE :: CABELO E PELE]
Cabelo preto liso, repartido ao meio, com franja lateral e mechas soltas cruzando o rosto. As pontas do lado direito inferior são mais claras, acinzentadas. Pele com acabamento suave de câmera de celular, textura natural discreta, pintas e pequenas irregularidades de tom preservadas, sem poros exagerados. Sem maquiagem aparente.

[OBJECTS / SPACE :: COROA E AMBIENTE]
Coroa floral assimétrica, cruzando a testa em diagonal (não alinhada à margem superior):
- esquerda: peônia rosa grande, uma flor rosada menor e uma flor laranja na altura da orelha;
- centro: cacho de flores lilás-azuladas e um lírio amarelo-creme/pêssego com estames alaranjados, cujas pétalas caem sobre a testa;
- um fio de bagas verdes desce em diagonal pela esquerda e termina num pingente de flor creme sobre a têmpora;
- direita: botões verdes, um botão rosa-avermelhado, bagas brancas e flores brancas rendadas, com uma pequena flor magenta e amarela ao fundo.
Interior de carro ao fundo: encosto de cabeça escuro e estofado, teto com faixas de luz difusa no topo.

[LIGHT & OPTICS :: LUZ E ASSINATURA TÉCNICA]
Luz solar direta, dura, vinda do alto pela esquerda do quadro, e filtrada de modo que o rosto inteiro fica tingido de vermelho-alaranjado. A testa fica mais pêssego, e bochechas, nariz e lábios ficam em vermelhão-carmesim, com os lábios quase se fundindo à pele. Uma sombra recortada de folhagem ou ramo cai sobre a bochecha direita e a lateral do nariz. Estames e pétalas projetam sombras finas na testa. Brilho âmbar nas íris. Captura de grande-angular de celular (equivalente a 26mm f/1.8), foco nítido no rosto e fundo suavemente desfocado. A leve distorção de perspectiva da selfie próxima é desejada.

[COLOR GRADE :: MATIZ E CONTRASTE]
Dominante vermelho-laranja quente sobre toda a pele, com verde e lilás das flores ainda vivos por contraste. Altas luzes quentes e sombras profundas, contraste alto. Renderização de sensor de celular, com leve realce de saturação e sem correção para tom neutro.

[COMPOSITION :: ENQUADRAMENTO]
Selfie em grande plano e ângulo alto, íntima e próxima. O rosto preenche quase todo o quadro, a coroa corta a parte superior da testa e o cabelo e o teto do carro aparecem acima dela. Pouca profundidade de campo, com o rosto e as flores nítidos.

[NEGATIVE PROMPT :: EXCLUSÕES]
pele em tom neutro sem dominante vermelha, iluminação suave de sombra, coroa simétrica no topo da cabeça, flores genéricas, rosto simétrico, pele plástica, textura encerada, poros exagerados, iluminação de estúdio, pose de manequim, olhar posado, texto, marcas de água, logótipos.

[ASPECT RATIO]
--ar 3:4

[Frame 10 — Ambiental — O Momento de Saída — 28mm f/2.0]
[variation_logic: Plano aberto com o sujeito em pé, iniciando o movimento de deixar a mesa do lounge, fechando a narrativa do ensaio com impacto visual.]

[IDENTITY LOCK]
Young East Asian woman in early 20s, natural East Asian monolid/soft epicanthic fold definition, defined oval face, delicate jawline, smooth natural skin texture with visible pores and slight natural sebum sheen on high points under direct illumination, dark brown irises.

[VISUAL CONTEXT :: LINHAGEM E REGISTRO]
primary_lineage: Contemporary Nightlife Flash Candid Photography.
secondary_influence: Lo-fi Luxury Editorial Diary.
direction_spectrum_score: 4/10.
vocabulary_register:
required_terms: ["direct hard on-camera flash", "specular skin kick", "fall-off shadow", "raw candid moment", "nightclub snapshot texture"]
forbidden_terms: ["softbox", "studio beauty dish", "rim light", "cinematic gradient", "airbrushed canvas", "cgi render"]
symbolic_function_notes: Spontaneous departure snapshot capturing full outfit in motion.

[SUBJECT :: CORPO E EXPRESSÃO]
description: Young East Asian woman in her 20s standing up from the lounge sofa.
expression: Fleeting smile over her shoulder toward the camera, eyes bright and engaged, slight parting of lips as if saying goodbye, full of late-night charm.
clothing: Off-the-shoulder sheer watercolor printed dress in sage green and muted yellow tones, flowy skirt draping down to knee level, textured embellished neckline border, deep plunging central opening down the torso. Sculptural dark dangling drop earrings with gold discs swinging slightly, delicate gold chain pendant necklace.
pose: Standing upright, mid-step while turning back toward the lens, left foot forward bearing weight, right hand lightly brushing the back of the sofa, left arm hanging naturally at her side.

[BODY MECHANICS :: ANATOMIA INDEPENDENTE]
weight_distribution: 80% on forward left leg, right heel lifted slightly off the carpet in mid-stride.
torso_pelvis_counter_rotation: Hips angled 45 degrees away from camera; ribcage and shoulders turned back 30 degrees toward the lens.
spine_curve: Graceful standing spine with natural lumbar arch accentuated by the turn.
shoulder_asymmetry: Trailing right shoulder dipped slightly back; leading left shoulder raised and open.
head_neck_position: Head turned over right shoulder, jawline distinct against the bare shoulder.
arm_hand_independence: Right fingertips trailing along the plush velvet sofa back; left arm hanging naturally with loose, relaxed fingers.
Avoid: Static standing mannequin pose, flat foot placement, rigid neck turn.

[SURFACE :: CABELO, PELE E MAQUIAGEM]
Hair: Dark wavy hair tumbling over the back and left shoulder, catching the flash with high specular glint.
Skin: Radiant, healthy skin with micro-porosity visible on shoulders and back, glowing natural finish under direct flash.
Makeup: Emerald shimmer smoky eye looking brilliant in three-quarter view, winged liner sharp, glowing pink lips with wet-look reflections.

[OBJECTS / SPACE :: AMBIENTE E INVENTÁRIO]
Context: Upscale dim-lit hotel lounge cocktail bar at night.
environment_inventory: Dark blue velvet banquette sofa in midground, polished marble bar shelf fully visible with illuminated spirits bottles in the warm background, suspended brass orb lamps casting golden glows across the ceiling.
atmosphere: Luminous, high-end cocktail lounge energy winding down, frozen cleanly by direct snapshot strobe.
materials: Sheer watercolor chiffon, velvet upholstery, veined marble, illuminated liquor glass.

[LIGHT & OPTICS :: ILUMINAÇÃO E ASSINATURA TÉCNICA]
lighting: Hard direct on-camera flash creating a stark, crisp outline on the subject, throwing a distinct shadow onto the floor and banquette behind her.
lens: 28mm wide-angle equivalent lens at f/2.0.
camera_signature: Wide-angle snapshot capture, sharp foreground subject, warm background ambient glow dissolving into soft atmospheric depth.
white_balance: 5200K flash foreground, 2500K warm background ambient.

[COLOR GRADE :: MATIZ E CONTRASTE]
temperature: Dynamic separation between cool-neutral flash-lit subject and golden ambient cocktail bar.
saturation: Deep royal blues, rich sage greens, soft citrus yellow watercolor splashes.
contrast: High contrast snapshot style; sharp demarcation between illuminated figure and shadowed lounge corners.
shadows: Defined cast shadow falling behind the legs onto the floor carpet.
highlights: Crisp specular glints on gold earring discs, necklace pendant, and hair surface.
color_science_connotation: Authentic high-society nightlife snapshot processing.

[COMPOSITION :: ENQUADRAMENTO E PROFUNDIDADE]
framing: Full-length environmental standing portrait, subject commanding the left two-thirds of frame.
point_of_view: Eye level of a seated companion looking up as she stands to leave.
foreground_elements: Corner of the velvet sofa framing the lower edge.
background: Backlit marble bar counter and glowing amber orb lamps.
depth_of_field: Moderate; subject sharply defined, bar interior legibly soft behind.

[ANATOMICAL REINFORCEMENT :: CHECKLIST DE CORREÇÃO]
Realistic weight shift in walking gait; natural ankle and calf muscle tension on the lifted heel; smooth organic rotation of the neck over the shoulder.

[NEGATIVE PROMPT :: EXCLUSÕES DINÂMICAS]
softbox, studio beauty dish, rim light, cinematic gradient, airbrushed canvas, cgi render, 3d render, digital illustration, smooth plastic skin, missing fingers, malformed legs, stiff mannequin posture, daytime light, text, watermark.

items.rawPrompt:
Aqui está um prompt estruturado seguindo as diretrizes do "Reality-First Prompt", inspirado na imagem fornecida, traduzido e adaptado para capturar a essência da cena com o máximo de realismo, ignorando os textos sobrepostos da imagem original.
 POSITIVE PROMPT 
 Constraints:
 9:16 vertical, foto ultrarrealista de smartphone, plano médio-inteiro de uma jovem mulher em um home office ou quarto. 
 Composition:
 Enquadramento da cabeça até os joelhos; a câmera está no nível dos olhos. 
 Ela está sentada com as pernas cruzadas sobre o assento de uma cadeira de escritório preta. 
 Uma das mãos repousa relaxada sobre a perna, enquanto o outro braço está erguido com o dedo indicador apontando para cima. 
 Rosto voltado para a câmera com uma expressão confiante e lábios levemente projetados (biquinho sutil). 
 Mesa e parede preenchendo o fundo, sem texto ou grafismos sobrepostos na imagem. 
 Environment:
 Quarto com aspecto de "uso real" (lived-in). Ao fundo, uma mesa de maquiagem/escritório contendo vários pequenos frascos de cosméticos, potes e pincéis. 
 Um espelho retangular comprido repousa sobre a mesa, refletindo parte do ambiente, e pequenos quadros emoldurados pendurados na parede ao fundo. 
 Iluminação interna quente e direcional, simulando uma ring light misturada com a luz ambiente do quarto, projetando sombras marcadas no lado não iluminado do rosto e do corpo. 
 Materials & textures:
 Cabelo longo, volumoso e ondulado, tingido de vermelho/magenta vibrante, com textura realista e alguns fios soltos (frizz natural). 
 Casaco de moletom cinza com zíper, com textura visível de algodão macio e caimento natural, usado aberto sobre um top preto. 
 Cadeira de escritório com textura de malha sintética (mesh). 
 Separação nítida entre o cabelo vermelho vibrante e o fundo mais escuro do quarto, sem fusão de bordas. 
 Primary focus (Realismo da pele e do cabelo):
 Textura da pele perfeitamente visível, com poros sutis, pequenas imperfeições naturais e brilho (oleosidade natural) nas maçãs do rosto e ponta do nariz. 
 Reflexos precisos da fonte de luz principal dentro das pupilas (catchlights). 
 Fios de cabelo com brilho especular realista onde a luz atinge as ondulações, mostrando variações sutis do tom vermelho. 
 Sombras de contato fisicamente precisas onde o tecido do casaco encosta na pele. 
 Color & light:
 Balanço de branco quente (tons amarelados e alaranjados predominantes na pele e no ambiente). 
 Alto contraste: áreas iluminadas bem definidas contra um fundo com sombras mais profundas e escuras. 
 Cores fiéis à realidade: o cabelo vermelho é vibrante, mas não fluorescente; nenhuma paleta lavada, pastel ou com filtro acinzentado. 
 Camera behavior:
 Simulação de câmera frontal de smartphone moderno (lente ligeiramente grande angular, cerca de 24mm-28mm equivalentes). 
 Leve profundidade de campo natural: o sujeito está em foco nítido, enquanto a mesa de cosméticos e a parede ao fundo apresentam um desfoque suave e natural da lente (sem efeito "Modo Retrato" artificial com recortes bruscos). 
 Presença de ruído digital sutil (grain) típico de sensores de celular em condições de luz interna. 
 Sem super-nitidez (no over-sharpening). 
 Overall aesthetic:
 Estética de criação de conteúdo para redes sociais (influencer selfie/video still). 
 Clima casual, íntimo e orgânico; parece uma captura de tela de um momento real e espontâneo, não um anúncio comercial de estúdio. 
 STRICT NEGATIVES 
text, text overlays, logos, watermarks, plastic skin, airbrushed, beauty filter, AI glow, bloom, 3D render, illustration, heavy color grading, washed out colors, fake bokeh, unnatural depth of field, over-sharpening, studio lighting backdrop, unnatural hair flow, blurry edges, floating objects.

items.rawPrompt:
Intérprete FDR [Hyper-Play Core] online. O Ecossistema Phygital está ativo (Low Angle + High Key).
 Recebi sua imagem de referência. Notei que o original utiliza uma estética de "Colagem 2D" e fundo verde chapado com tipografia pesada.
 ⚠️ ALERTA DE PROTOCOLO (Regra de Ouro): 
Meu sistema proíbe a renderização direta de texto ("RE MATRÍCULA", "são judas") dentro do prompt de imagem. A tipografia é tratada como Pós-Produção . Para a geração da imagem (o "Backplate"), converterei os conceitos textuais e gráficos 2D em Metáforas Visuais 3D para manter a coerência do universo Hyper-Play.
 Abaixo, apresento a Linha de Raciocínio FDR/Hyper-Play para transformar essa referência no nosso estilo proprietário:
 Linha de Raciocínio FDR/Hyper-Play: 
 DEFESA (Protocolo de Blindagem): 
 Bloqueando: "Flat design", "Paper cutouts", "Grunge textures", "Renderização de Texto". 
 Conversão: Os "stickers" (estrelas, smileys) serão transformados em objetos 3D flutuantes (Glossy Plastic & Metallic). O fundo verde chapado será substituído pelo degradê atmosférico da marca, mas manterei acentos de Verde Neon nos props para honrar a referência. 
 ECOSSISTEMA (Palco Imutável): 
 Câmera: Configurada para Low Angle / Worm's-eye view (Câmera no chão olhando para cima), garantindo heroísmo aos estudantes. 
 Lente: Grande Angular (Wide 24mm) para distorção dinâmica.

items.rawPrompt:
STUDIO EDITORIAL — SINGLE SHOT v4 (DRAMATIC)

INPUT A (model image): [attach]
INPUT B (clothing image): [attach]
POSE DIRECTION: [attach or leave free]

---

STEP 1 — VISUAL EXTRACTION (internal, do not output):

From INPUT A — Model:
Extract: skin tone value (light / medium / tan / deep),
skin undertone (warm / cool / neutral), body proportions,
hair color and texture, facial structure, physical build,
energy archetype (delicate / neutral / powerful / angular).

From INPUT B — Clothing:
Extract: clothing value (light / medium / dark), dominant
color temperature (warm / cool / neutral), fabric weight
and surface language (matte / glossy / washed / fluid /
structured / raw / reflective), silhouette category,
styling signals, cultural or subcultural coding of the look.

Note: if clothing is dark or highly reflective, flag this —
it will affect rim light intensity in Step 4 to ensure
separation from dark background zones.

---

STEP 2 — BACKGROUND SYSTEM (fixed, do not alter):

ENVIRONMENT: dark radial chiaroscuro studio.
A three-zone radial gradient emanating from behind the
subject outward — not a flat backdrop, not a wall.
Color reads as atmosphere and depth, not set design.

ZONE 1 — UPPER FIELD / EDGE VIGNETTE (darkest):
HEX: #100808
RGB: rgb(16, 8, 8)
HSL: hsl(0°, 33%, 5%)
— Near-black with the faintest warm undertone.
— Must read as true dark, not charcoal gray.
— Occupies top third and lateral edges of frame.

ZONE 2 — RADIAL CENTER / GEL BLOOM (crimson core):
HEX: #8C1C1C
RGB: rgb(140, 28, 28)
HSL: hsl(0°, 67%, 33%)
— Deep blood crimson. The color radiates from directly
  behind the subject at mid-torso to shoulder height.
— Not neon red. Not orange-red. Not pink-red.
— Saturated enough to read as charged color; dark enough
  to feel dangerous, not theatrical.
— The bloom should feel like heat source or aura — not
  a painted flat surface.

ZONE 3 — LOWER FIELD / FLOOR FADE (lightest):
HEX: #EDE5E5
RGB: rgb(237, 229, 229)
HSL: hsl(0°, 13%, 91%)
— Near-white floor with very faint warm blush.
— Reflective, clean, minimal. Floor and subject
  base feel grounded and real against the dark field.

GRADIENT TYPE: radial, centered at subject's mid-back.
Not linear. Not top-to-bottom. Color emanates outward
from the subject's silhouette like a halo or pressure field.

GRADIENT TRANSITION: smooth and continuous. No banding,
no visible horizon line, no hard edge between zones.
The crimson bleeds upward into dark and downward into pale.

COLOR TEMPERATURE of environment: mixed intentionally —
crimson background is warm (2800–3200K equivalent),
key light on subject is cool (5500–6200K).
This temperature conflict is structural, not accidental.

HUE LOCK: crimson core fixed at hsl(0°). No deviation
toward magenta (H>10°), no deviation toward orange (H<350°
going warm). Saturated red only.

PROHIBITED backgrounds:
— Pure black flat backdrop
— Pure white or neutral gray backdrop
— Mint, teal, or cool-toned environment
— Colored gel wash evenly distributed across background
— Any background reading as "theater stage" or "concert"
— Gradient that reads as sunset or sky
— Visible texture, grain, or noise on backdrop wall
— Split flat diptych background
— Any sense of physical location (room, alley, studio wall)

The background must feel: pressurized, atmospheric,
operatic without being theatrical — the color is force,
not decoration.

---

STEP 3 — POSE & CAMERA SELECTION (internal):

PHILOSOPHY:
The pose must feel like a decision, not a default.
Prioritize physical tension, weight, and confrontation
over elegance or symmetry. The subject dominates the frame.
Think editorial power, not commercial compliance.
The dramatic environment demands a pose that earns it —
do not place a passive body inside an active background.

If POSE DIRECTION is specified: follow it faithfully
but interpret with maximum commitment and physicality.

If free: choose the pose that makes the clothing feel
like a manifesto, not a product. Ask what posture this
environment calls for — a background this charged
requires a subject who commands it.

---

POSE REPERTOIRE — DRAMATIC EDITION:

CONFRONTATIONAL / POWER POSES:

items.rawPrompt:
EDITORIAL CONCEPT: A dynamic, high-fashion editorial capture focusing on fluid motion, architectural elegance, and spontaneous grace. The image captures a candid-feeling moment of a modern woman moving through a historic space, showcasing the interplay between lightweight fabrics and structured environments.
SUBJECT INITIAL IDENTITY & CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: A young Caucasian woman with long, voluminous blonde hair that catches the air as she moves. She has a natural, radiant complexion with minimal makeup, soft contouring, and light pink lips, exuding a sense of effortless elegance.
EXPRESSION & POSE: Captured mid-stride, walking directly toward the camera with a relaxed, slightly surprised expression, her mouth parted softly. Her body exhibits a natural, fluid walking posture. In her right hand, extended slightly outward, she balances a single peach. In her left hand, cradled against her hip, she carries a small bundle of three more ripe peaches, integrating the fruit into her movement.
WARDROBE & ACCESSORIES: She wears a floor-length, bias-cut cream silk slip dress that drapes elegantly over her figure, showcasing subtle movement folds. The dress features a delicate lace bodice with fine spaghetti straps. Her accessories include a statement white resin bangle on her right wrist, a gold cuff on her left wrist, and elegant low-heeled mules with a white and brown cross-strap design.
ENVIRONMENT & SCENOGRAPHY: The interior is a grand room within a historic Mediterranean mansion, featuring high ceilings and a warm terracotta brick floor laid in a herringbone pattern. In the background, a long, dark wood dining table holds various decorative objects, flanked by vintage wooden chairs. A large accent mirror with a carved frame stands against the wall, alongside a minimalist white ceramic vase.
LIGHTING DESIGN: The scene is illuminated by a mixture of diffuse natural light from large windows and a soft overhead ambient glow. The light gracefully rakes across the herringbone floor and highlights the gloss of the silk dress, creating smooth gradients and soft, natural shadows that ground her feet.
CAMERA ARCHITECTURE & TECHNICAL SPECS: Captured on a Sony A7R V with a Sony FE 35mm f/1.4 GM lens. The 35mm focal length provides an immersive, wide environmental portrait perspective. Aperture is set to f/2.2 to create a gentle separation between the moving subject and the deep background scenery. Shutter speed: 1/250s to crisp-freeze the gentle motion. ISO: 320.
WHITE BALANCE CONFIGURATION: Set to Auto White Balance with an internal warmth bias (approx. 5500K) to keep the cream fabric looking pristine and ivory-toned, while beautifully rendering the warm red brick floor and the natural skin tones.
MICRO-TEXTURES & FIDELITY: Beautifully detailed rendering of fabric fluidity. The micro-textures of the silk sheen, the distinct lace mesh wiring, the fine wood grain of the distant table, and the matte, porous finish of the terracotta bricks are all preserved. The skin tones remain completely natural with realistic textures, fine hair details, and light reflections.

items.rawPrompt:
STUDIO EDITORIAL — BEACHWEAR SINGLE SHOT
AESTHETIC SYSTEM: non-no × Numéro Tokyo (Japanese Summer Editorial)

INPUT A (model image): [attach]
INPUT B (swimwear image): [attach]
POSE DIRECTION: realistic night photography editorial, young woman 
kneeling on the passenger seat of a car interior facing camera, 
both hands placed on the seat cushion leaning slightly forward, 
neutral expression with slightly pursed lips, direct eye contact 
with lens, long wavy vibrant reddish-orange hair falling loosely, 
fair skin, light-colored eyes, white sleeveless top with delicate 
lace trim neckline, light blue denim jeans, black shoes with small 
decorative detail, car interior fully visible — beige and gray 
upholstery, door panel, overhead dome light illuminated casting 
warm ambient glow, sun visors down, window frames, dark exterior 
glass reflecting blurred city buildings and bokeh street lights, 
lighting: warm tungsten interior dome light as key source 
contrasting with cool dark blue nighttime urban exterior visible 
through windows, shallow depth of field with sharp focus on subject 
and soft bokeh on city lights behind glass, shot from outside the 
car through the passenger window at eye level, cinematic urban 
night atmosphere --profile spc2tb2

STEP 1 — VISUAL EXTRACTION (internal, do not output):

From INPUT A — Model:
Extract: skin tone (light / medium / tan / deep),
skin undertone (warm / cool / neutral), body proportions,
hair color, length and texture, facial structure and features.

From INPUT B — Swimwear:
Extract: silhouette category (bikini / one-piece / tankini /
boardshort / rashguard), dominant color temperature
(warm / cool / neutral / multicolor), fabric surface
(matte jersey, shiny lycra, textured ribbed, printed cotton,
woven linen, metallic), pattern language (solid, geometric,
floral, abstract), coverage area, structural details
(straps, hardware, cutouts, ruching, embroidery, logo placement).

---

STEP 2 — BACKGROUND SELECTION (internal):

FIXED BRAND IDENTITY BACKDROP: seamless gradient sky —
a smooth, luminous gradient that transitions from a saturated
cerulean or sky blue at the top to a softer, lighter powder
blue or near-white at the horizon zone.
Think open sky at midday — vivid but not neon,
atmospheric but not hazy.

The gradient is seamless and continuous — no clouds,
no texture, no horizon line, no ground plane visible.
Pure tonal transition from deep sky blue (top) to
pale icy blue or blue-white (bottom).
The background reads as infinite atmospheric depth.

There is no sand, no water, no beach environment visible.
The subject exists against pure gradient sky — as if
suspended in open air. This is the visual identity anchor
of the series and must be preserved exactly across all shots.

LIGHTING SYSTEM:
Consistent with the sky backdrop — cool-neutral white balance
6000–6500K to harmonize with the blue tones.

  MAIN LIGHT: key light simulates a high directional sun or
  large diffused sky source. Angle: 30–45° from subject.
  Shadow edges are soft but defined. No warm gels.

  FILL: controlled fill ratio 1:2 to 1:3 — preserves shadow
  detail on fabric and skin without flattening the subject.

  QUALITY: no studio box feel — the light must feel like
  filtered open sky. Crisp, clean, slightly cool.
  Skin reads luminous and natural against the blue field.

  RIM / SEPARATION: rim or separation light acceptable and
  encouraged — the subject must read clearly against the
  blue gradient. The cooler the swimwear, the more essential
  the rim separation becomes.

---

STEP 3 — POSE & CAMERA SELECTION (internal):

PHILOSOPHY:
Japanese fashion editorial poses exist between two poles:
on one side, dynamic physical energy — movement, rhythm, joy,
the body in action. On the other, graphic stillness — the body
as a composed visual element, deliberate and controlled.
Both read as fashion. Neither reads as commercial or catalog.

The pose must communicate the spirit of the swimwear:
  — Playful / colorful / patterned → choose energy, movement,
    expression. The image should feel like a summer memory.
  — Minimal / structural / monochrome → choose graphic stillness.
    The body becomes architecture. Stillness is the statement.

If POSE DIRECTION is specified: follow it faithfully
but interpret with maximum personality and visual intelligence.

If free: evaluate the swimwear's spirit and select accordingly.

---

POSE REPERTOIRE — JAPANESE SUMMER EDITORIAL EDITION:

ENERGY & MOVEMENT (non-no / Ray register):

  — MID-STRIDE WALK:
    Model walking directly toward camera on sand or in shallow
    water. One foot forward, one back. Arms swinging naturally —
    not symmetrical. Hair caught mid-movement. Face turned
    30° toward camera, expression: caught mid-thought, not posed.
    Camera: knee-to-hip height, slight upward angle.
    Creates forward momentum. Feels like a film still.

  — WATER INTERACTION:
    Model stepping into or wading through ankle-deep water.
    One leg lifted mid-step, creating water disturbance.
    Arms: one slightly raised for balance, one natural.
    Body in slight forward lean. Gaze down at water or
    directly at camera with a flash of attention.
    Camera: eye level, wide enough to include water surface.

  — JUMP AT PEAK:
    Model captured at the exact apex of a vertical jump.
    Both feet off ground. Legs: either fully extended downward
    (clean) or knees bent symmetrically pulled toward chest.
    Arms: can be extended outward or raised above head.
    Hair at maximum upward arc. Expression: open, alive —
    mouth open or pure kinetic focus.
    Camera: just below waist level shooting slightly up.
    Background: pure sky. Model reads as suspended against blue.

  — TURN MID-MOVEMENT:
    Model mid-rotation — body in pivot, torso facing one direction,
    face catching camera mid-turn, hair fanning outward.
    One arm extended outward from centrifugal motion.
    Subtle motion blur on hair tips and extremities acceptable.
    Camera: eye level, 3/4 angle.

GRAPHIC STILLNESS (Numéro Tokyo register):

  — SEATED GRAPHIC:
    Model seated on dry sand or a flat rock.
    Legs extended straight forward and together, hands flat
    on sand beside hips — arms straight and locked.
    Back straight, chin level. Body forms a clean L shape.
    Swimwear silhouette reads without distraction.
    Gaze: direct into lens, or 90° profile looking at horizon.
    Camera: eye level or very slightly above. Horizontal frame.

  — STANDING PROFILE:
    Model standing fully in profile — shoulder toward camera.
    Feet together, arms relaxed at sides or one hand raised
    to touch chin or collar. Face in absolute profile.
    Body weight even, spine neutral.
    Camera: exact eye level. 85mm tight enough to cut feet,
    crown, and background into simple vertical shapes.

  — WATER REFLECTION OVERHEAD:
    Model lying in very shallow water (water covers no more than
    the back of legs and arms). Body arranged diagonally across
    frame. One arm extended above head, one resting on
    stomach or hip. Face turned up toward camera.
    Camera: 45–60° overhead, shooting down. Water surface
    creates reflections around the body. Highly graphic.
    The swimwear and body read as a composed object from above.

  — BODY IN MOTION, FACE STILL:
    Hair mid-throw (model threw hair back just before capture).
    Body planted, weight even, arms relaxed.
    Face fully visible, expression calm and direct while
    hair creates an arc of movement around the head.
    Camera: eye level, slight 3/4 angle. 85mm aesthetic.
    The contrast between body stillness and hair motion

items.rawPrompt:
Esta imagem possui uma composição fascinante que mistura o realismo clássico com elementos de mistério e autorreflexão. Para criar uma versão aprimorada ou inspirada nela usando o Nano Banana Pro , selecionei a abordagem de Retrato em Exposição de Museu (inspirada na categoria 1.14 do guia), pois ela preserva a elegância e o diálogo entre a pessoa e a obra de arte.
 Aqui está o prompt otimizado:
 Uma fotografia de nível editorial e comercial inspirada na referência enviada, mantendo a identidade facial, o cabelo cacheado volumoso e a estrutura corporal da mulher com 100% de precisão.
COMPOSIÇÃO: 
A mulher está sentada de costas para a câmera sobre uma superfície de piano preta polida, criando um reflexo nítido abaixo dela. Ela segura um pequeno espelho de mão dourado e ornamentado em estilo barroco, posicionado de forma que o espectador veja seu rosto perfeitamente refletido no espelho, com batom vermelho profundo e um olhar intenso.
AMBIENTE E ARTE:
Ao fundo, na parede cinza suave, está pendurada uma tela de arte abstrata em tons de azul profundo, ciano e turquesa, com texturas de pinceladas visíveis (estilo impasto). A iluminação do museu foca na textura da pintura e no brilho dourado do espelho.
VESTUÁRIO E DETALHES:
Ela usa um vestido de veludo devoré em tom nude/rosê com padrões florais intrincados e mangas sino fluidas. A textura do tecido deve ser tátil e luxuosa.
ESTILO FOTOGRÁFICO:
Capturado em uma lente 35mm f/1.8 para uma profundidade de campo média. Iluminação dramática com contraste suave (chiaroscuro), realçando a textura da pele e a elegância da pose. Qualidade 8K UHD, renderização de texturas hiper-realista.
 O que eu fiz nesta otimização: 
 Consistência de Identidade: Garanti que os traços da imagem original (cabelo, rosto e pose) sejam o ponto central. 
 Refinamento de Textura: Adicionei detalhes sobre o tecido "veludo devoré" e a superfície do piano para maximizar o poder de renderização do modelo. 
 Foco Narrativo: Reforcei o elemento do espelho como o ponto de foco emocional, uma técnica comum em prompts de alta fidelidade. 
 Gostaria que eu gerasse uma variação desta imagem em um estilo diferente, como uma pintura a óleo clássica ou um cenário de filme noir?

variation_logic: Explora a interação física com o cenário, apoiando o corpo contra a lateral da prateleira de pelúcias, integrando os elementos decorativos ao espaço do sujeito.

[IDENTITY LOCK]
Female subject, curvy hourglass-pear proportions with natural soft contours, warm olive-neutral undertones revealing subtle natural dermal folds at waist, delicate bone structure on shoulders and collarbones, straight blunt-cut brown fringed bangs skimming just above the eyebrows with mid-length brown hair falling along the shoulders.

[VISUAL CONTEXT :: LINHAGEM E REGISTRO]
primary_lineage: authentic domestic smartphone mirror capture, non-editorial casual documentation.
secondary_influence: candid social media feed direct upload, vernacular domestic realism.
direction_spectrum_score: 3/10

required_terms: ["harsh ceiling bulb", "mirror surface dust specks", "natural skin folds", "unretouched pores", "ambient indoor compression", "smartphone metering"]
forbidden_terms: ["airbrushed skin", "rim light", "softbox", "studio strobe", "cinematic volumetric rays", "octabank", "poreless", "glamour retouched"]
symbolic_function_notes: Casual, comfortable occupation of domestic space, blending youthful personal belongings with uncurated personal portraiture.

[SUBJECT :: CORPO E EXPRESSÃO]
description: Curvy young woman in two-piece swimwear interacting physically with her surroundings.
expression: Gentle subtle smile with closed lips, eyes looking directly into the smartphone camera lens reflection with quiet confidence.
clothing: Blue and orange Mediterranean tile pattern bikini; halter ties knotted securely at the nape, side ties on the bikini briefs resting comfortably over the iliac crests.
accessories: Silver belly button ring; subtle reddish curved tattoo visible along the inner left forearm.
pose: Leaning her left upper arm and hip lightly against the side edge of the wooden shelf; right arm raised holding the smartphone at eye level to capture the angled reflection; left hand resting flat against the front edge of the shelf beside the colorful plush toys.

[BODY MECHANICS :: ANATOMIA INDEPENDENTE]
weight_distribution: 60% of weight braced through the left hip and arm against the wooden shelf, 40% on right leg.
torso_pelvis_counter_rotation: Torso angled 35 degrees toward the left shelf, head turning slightly right to face the mirror.
spine_curve: Lateral spinal curve leaning toward the support surface, producing natural skin compression on the left flank.
shoulder_asymmetry: Left shoulder pressed back and down against the shelf; right shoulder elevated and extended forward to frame the phone.
head_neck_position: Head tilted 8 degrees toward the right, chin slightly up.
arm_hand_independence: Left palm flattened against the shelf edge with relaxed fingers; right wrist angled sharply to stabilize the camera phone.
Avoid: Floating postures, stiff detached posing, perfectly straight spine, lack of body contact with furniture.

[SURFACE :: CABELO, PELE E MAQUIAGEM]
Hair: Natural brown hair falling forward over the right collarbone, bangs neatly parted across the forehead with slight natural separation.
Skin: Warm authentic skin showing realistic texture, tiny creases at the leaning waist, subtle softness on the upper thighs.
Makeup: Clean natural look, subtle natural brow texture, unpainted lips with natural color.

[OBJECTS / SPACE :: AMBIENTE E INVENTÁRIO]
Context: Intimate bedroom corner emphasizing the juxtaposition between the model and her collection of personal objects.
environment_inventory: Prominent focus on the stack of colorful plushies right beside her arm; the multi-colored crocheted blanket hangs down prominently, its textured wool stitches clearly defined; neutral wall visible across the right half of the frame.
imperfections: Fingerprints and light smudges along the left margin of the mirror; micro-scratches on the wooden shelf edge.
materials: Wool yarn, stuffed plush fabric, unfinished wood, mirror glass, lycra swimwear.

[LIGHT & OPTICS :: ILUMINAÇÃO E ASSINATURA TÉCNICA]
lighting: Downward incandescent ceiling bulb casting light across the top of the plush toys and subject's shoulders, creating soft ambient bounce off the crochet fabric into the shadows.
camera_signature: Wide-angle mobile sensor rendering high local detail, crisp textures on the plushies and yarn, deep domestic depth of field.
lens: 28mm equivalent f/1.8 wide lens, true-to-life perspective without distortion.
white_balance: Warm 3150K indoor auto-balance.

[COLOR GRADE :: MATIZ E CONTRASTE]
temperature: Warm, inviting domestic amber tones.
saturation: High color richness from the multi-colored granny-square blanket and plush toys harmonizing with the bikini’s blue and orange print.
contrast: Natural domestic contrast, defined shadows under the shelf ledges and subject's curves.
shadows: Warm umber and dark sienna.
highlights: Soft specular highlights on hair fibers, silver belly ring, and plush plastic eyes.
color_science_connotation: High-clarity smartphone JPEG with subtle natural compression.

[COMPOSITION :: ENQUADRAMENTO E PROFUNDIDADE]
framing: Vertical medium-full shot capturing from just below the knees to above the hair.
point_of_view: Slightly low mirror angle, looking upward across the subject leaning into the shelf.
foreground_elements: Corner dust and smudges on the lower mirror surface.
background: Bedroom wall and shadowed wardrobe frame serving as quiet backdrop behind the colorful shelf.
depth_of_field: Deep, keeping the textures of both the plushies and the crochet blanket tactile and sharp.

Clear physical compression visible where the left hip and flank press against the furniture.

Left fingers resting on the shelf show realistic weight transfer and joint bend.

Reddish curved tattoo on left inner forearm remains consistent in line weight and location.

Natural abdominal volume responds realistically to the leaning posture.

Bangs maintain consistent length and density across the forehead.
